A table nested in a single-cell row renders as its own table

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><th>Summary</th></tr><tr><td>Before<table><tr><th>Item</th><th>Amount</th></tr><tr><td>Alpha</td><td>10</td></tr></table></td></tr></table>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
